570106.title: Argos
570106.description: Argos was a city of ancient Greece that reached its cultural highpoint under Pheidon in the seventh century BC.

579885.title: Athenae
579885.description: A major Greek city-state and the principal city of Attika. Modern Athens in Greece.

540703.title: Chalcis
540703.description: Chalkis was a settlement on Euboea, inhabited from the sub-Neolithic period, which played an important role in Greek colonisation of the Mediterranean in the 8th century BC. It was part of the Delian League in the 5th century BC and the Second Athenian Sea League in the 4th century BC. In Hellenistic times it was one of the three 'fetters of Greece' used by Macedon to control Greece. It came under Roman control in 197 BC.

530834.title: Corcyra (settlement)
530834.description: The eponymous settlement of the island of Corcyra (modern Korfu).

570182.title: Corinthus/Korinthos
570182.description: The ancient Greek and Roman city of Corinth, located in the Peloponnese, Greece. Also known today as Archaia Korinthos and not to be confused with the nearby modern town.

599587.title: Delos (settlement)
599587.description: The ancient settlement of Delos, located on the Aegean island of the same name.

540726.title: Delphi

names.romanized: Dilfi, Delfey, DLFY, DLFI, Odaj, dlfy

540726.description: The ancient panhellenic sanctuary of Delphi in Greece, seat of the oracle of Apollo.

599612.title: Ephesus/Arsinoe(ia)
599612.description: Ephesus/Arsinoe(ia) was the most important ancient metropolis of Ionian Asia Minor.

599636.title: Halicarnassus/Halikarnassos
599636.description: An ancient city in Caria, now known as Bodrum in Turkey.

599799.title: Miletus
599799.description: A major ancient city in Ionia.

550763.title: Mytilene
550763.description: An ancient settlement. The early fortified core of the city was located on an islet off the east coast of Lesbos, now joined to the mainland. That site is dominated by the remains of a Byzantine fortress with Ottoman and Genoese repairs and additions. This original city later expanded onto the main island.

570531.title: Olympia
570531.description: Ancient sanctuary of Zeus and home of the ancient Olympic games.

491687.title: Pella/Diokletianoupolis
491687.description: Capital of the Kingdom of Macedonia.

590030.title: Rhodos (settlement)
590030.description: A settlement on the island of Rhodes.

599925.title: Samos (settlement)
599925.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 61 D2 Samos

550867.title: Sardis/Hyde?
550867.description: Sardis was the capital of the Lydian Empire, located in western Turkey. In 188 B.C. Sardis became a part of the Attalid kingdom, and thus it passed with the territory of Attalus III to Rome in 133 B.C.

570685.title: Sparta
570685.description: Sparta was a prominent city-state (polis) of ancient Greece.

541138.title: Thebai/Thebae
541138.description: The ancient city of Thebes in Boeotia (modern Greece).

501325.title: Abydos
501325.description: A city of Mysia located on the Hellespont.

501339.title: Akanthos
501339.description: An ancient settlement in the northeast of the Chalkidiki. The large site is immediately southeast of the modern town of Ierissos.

579853.title: Aigina (settlement)
579853.description: The primary ancient settlement on the Aegean island of the same name.

530794.title: Ambracia
530794.description: Ambracia (modern Arta) was an ancient city of central Greece, founded as a colony of Corinth in the seventh century BCE. It was located near the Ambracian Gulf along the course of the river Arachthos.

501347.title: Amphipolis
501347.description: A Greek city in Thrace located on the east bank of the Strymon river, Amphipolis was originally founded as an Athenian colony.

540667.title: Artemision
540667.description: The possible site of the temple of Artemis Proseoa beneath the Ag. Georgios chapel, Artemision (Kourbatsi) Euboea.

520985.title: Byzantium
520985.description: An ancient Greek settlement at the southern end of the Bosphorus, where modern-day Istanbul, Turkey, now stands. It flourished and grew throughout the Greek and Roman periods. The city was renamed Constantinopolis (q.v..) and much expanded by the fourth-century emperor, Constantine, and his successors.

540701.title: Chaeronea
540701.description: An ancient settlement of Boeotia, Chaeronea was a subject of Orchomenus and a member of the Boeotian League. From the late fifth century BC, Chaeronea belonged to one of the 11 Boeotian districts.

550496.title: Chios (settlement)
550496.description: The principal ancient city on the Aegean island of Chios.

501469.title: Kleonai
501469.description: An ancient settlement, located on the Athos/Akte peninsula.

570361.title: Kleonai
570361.description: An ancient city located in the mountainous area southwest of Corinth. The acropolis of ancient Kleonai lies about two kilometers east of the modern town named after it in the 1960s (Archaies Kleones, formerly Kontostavlos).

599577.title: Colophon
599577.description: Colophon was an Ionian city in Lydia, located ca. 13 km north of the harbour of Notion. Its ruins are located near modern Değirmendere.

511218.title: Cyzicus
511218.description: An ancient city of Mysia in Anatolia, perhaps founded by the Corinthians in 756 BC and then again by the Milesians ca. 675 BC. Its advantageous position in the Propontis made it a major commercial centre. In the 5th century BC it was part of the Delian League and in the Hellenistic Age it was close to the Attalid kings. In the Imperial period, it became an assize centre (conventus) of the province of Asia.

491572.title: Dion
491572.description: Dion was a settlement of Pieria located on the border between Macedonia and Thessaly. It was held, traditionally, as the place of Orpheus' death and burial. In the Roman Imperial period, it became a Roman colonia. The adjacent modern village, now known as Dion, is sometimes also referenced by its earlier modern name Malathria.

530843.title: Dodona (Epirus)
530843.description: An ancient site of northwestern Epirus, Dodona was home to one of the most ancient oracular traditions of the Hellenic world.

579920.title: Eleusis
579920.description: Eleusis, located some 22 km west of Athens, was the site of the cult of Demeter and the sanctuary where the Eleusinian Mysteries were celebrated from the Bronze Age to the Roman Imperial period. It was a coastal deme of the Hippothontis tribe and the site of a military garrison in the Classical and Hellenistic periods.

570220.title: Elis (city)
570220.description: Elis was an ancient Greek city of the northwest Peloponnese that served as the capital of the district of the same name.

570228.title: Epidauros
570228.description: Epidauros is located on a small peninsula on the eastern coast of Peloponnesus.

579925.title: Eretria (Euboea)
579925.description: Eretria was an ancient polis located in Euboea.

530974.title: Leucas
530974.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 54 C4 Leucas

540913.title: Leuktra
540913.description: Leuktra was a settlement located in ancient Boeotia. It was located along the road leading from Thespiae to Plataea, somewhere in the vicinity of the modern town. In 371 B.C. the Thebans defeated the Spartans in a celebrated battle near the site.

570459.title: Mantineia/Antigoneia
570459.description: Mantineia/Antigoneia was an ancient settlement in Greece most noted for being the site of two major battles. The First Battle of Mantineia was the largest land battle of the Peloponnesian War (418 B.C.) and the Second Battle of Mantineia brought an end to Theban hegemony (362 B.C.).

580021.title: Marathon
580021.description: Marathon was a coastal deme of the tribe Aiantis, in northeastern Attica, the site of the Battle of Marathon in 490 BC, and capital of the Marathon tetrapolis.

570468.title: Megara
570468.description: Megara was an important ancient city of Greece, located in the northern part of the the Isthmus of Corinth opposite the island of Salamis.

570474.title: Melos (settlement)
570474.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 58 G4 Melos

501515.title: Mende
501515.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 51 A5 Mende

550738.title: Methymna
550738.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 C3 Methymna

570504.title: Nemea
570504.description: Nemea, located north of Argos, was the site of the Panhellenic Games and the Sanctuary of Nemean Zeus.

491678.title: Olynthos
491678.description: Olynthos was an ancient city of the Chalcidice, founded in the seventh century B.C. and destroyed in 348 B.C. by the forces of Philip II of Macedon.

540987.title: Orchomenos/Orchomenus (Boeotia)
540987.description: The so-called "Boeotian Orchomenos", located in the vicinity of the Byzantine church of Panaghia Skripou. The longer, modern title is used to distinguish this settlement from another Greek site with the same ancient name located in Arcadia in the Peloponnese.

570602.title: Phleious
570602.description: An ancient city located in the valley of the river Asopos.

580062.title: Peiraieus/Piraeus
580062.description: The ancient, fortified port settlement of ancient Athens. It was also the coastal deme of the tribe Hippothoontis.

541063.title: Plataea
541063.description: Plataea is an ancient city of Boeotia, located south of Thebes. In 479 BC Plataea was the site of the Battle of Plataea, in which an allied Greek army defeated the Persians. Plataea was destroyed in the Peloponnesian War by Thebes and Sparta in 427 BC and rebuilt in 386 BC.

491701.title: Poteidaia/Kassandreia
491701.description: Poteidaia/Kassandreia was a Greek colony founded ca. 600 BC by Corinthians on the peninsula of Pallene in western Chalcidice. The site received a Roman colony in 43 B.C. and in 30 B.C. Augustus settled veterans there, renaming it as Colonia Iulia Augusta Cassandrensis.

570640.title: Pylos/Koryphasion
570640.description: A Classical settlement, probably the Pylos of Thucydides, on the Koryphasion promontory, (modern Akr. Koryphasiou in Messenia) in the Peloponnese.

501620.title: Skione
501620.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 51 B5 Skione

501609.title: Sestos
501609.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 51 G4 Sestos

570707.title: Tegea
570707.description: Tegea was an ancient city of Arcadia. It is especially noted for its sanctuary dedicated to Athena Alea.

599971.title: Thera
599971.description: An ancient settlement located atop the modern Messavouno mountain on the island that shared its name in antiquity (modern Thira/Santorini).

541140.title: Thermopylae
541140.description: Thermopylae is the name of a narrow pass leading from Thessaly into Locris. It was the site of a pivotal battle during the Graeco-Persian wars in 480 BC.

501646.title: Torone
501646.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 51 B5 Torone

540905.title: Larissa
540905.description: The ancient capital of the Thessalian Pelasgiotis, modern Larisa in Greece.

501323.title: Abdera
501323.description: Abdera was a coastal city located on Cape Bulustra, near the estuary of the river Nestos.

550823.title: Phocaea
550823.description: An ancient settlement of Asia Minor, modern Foça in Turkey.

580100.title: Salamis (settlement)
580100.description: The ancient city of Salamis was located on the Saronic island of the same name, overlooking the modern Ampelaki Bay to the east. The site was likely largely in the area now covered by the modern city of Ambelaki/Ampelaki.

550569.title: Hephaistia
550569.description: An ancient settlement on the northern coast of the Greek island of Lemnos.

550755.title: Myrina
550755.description: An ancient place, cited: BAtlas 56 A2 Myrina
